name: logseq-youtube-notes
description: Format a YouTube video transcript inside a Logseq page into clean, navigable, timestamped Logseq-Flavored Markdown. Use when the user pastes a raw YouTube transcript, asks to organize/clean up video notes, add clickable {{youtube-timestamp}} headings, or structure a {{video ...}} block's notes. Do not use for non-video transcripts or for general LFM formatting (that is the logseq-lfm skill / logseq-core rule).
